documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome

analysis.summary: Goldiam International reported a strong operational performance in Q1 FY27, driven by robust export demand for lab-grown diamond jewelry, particularly in the U.S. and newer markets like the Middle East and Israel. EBITDA margins expanded to 24% following tariff refunds and the implementation of a dual-casting method, while the B2B order book stood at INR2,250 million. The company's India-focused retail brand, ORIGEM, operated 26 stores with plans to add more ahead of Diwali. Management expressed confidence in maintaining robust growth momentum across both B2B and B2C segments.

guidance.claim: The company expects double-digit revenue growth for FY27.
guidance.quote: We hope for and we are looking forward to build towards a very positive growth, double-digit growth in FY '27 on an overall basis.

guidance.claim: Management targets an exit monthly revenue of about INR7 crores for the ORIGEM business by the end of FY27.
guidance.quote: So we are hoping and targeting an exit revenue of about INR7 crores per month for FY '27 for the ORIGEM business.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that they are looking forward to a robust Q2 and Q3 compared to FY26.
demand_outlook.quote: We are looking forward to a robust Q2, Q3 compared to already record FY26, and we hope to continue the growth.

demand_outlook.claim: Demand remains positive specifically in the lab-grown diamond studded jewelry space.
demand_outlook.quote: So yes, the demand scenario continues to look positive, specifically in the lab-grown diamond studded jewelry space.

demand_outlook.claim: Retailers are moving to lower gold karatage to manage higher raw material costs and maintain end-customer price points.
demand_outlook.quote: In general, we see our retailers in order to minimize the advent of higher raw material costs, specifically in gold, moving down in Kt.

demand_outlook.claim: Bridal jewelry accounts for about 50% and fashion jewelry accounts for about 50% of the U.S. jewelry market.
demand_outlook.quote: It's -- so in general, for the U.S. jewelry industry, bridal jewelry is about 50% of the market and fashion jewelry is about 50% of the market.

capex_expansion.claim: Goldiam has 26 operational ORIGEM stores across key cities as of the reporting date.
capex_expansion.quote: As on date, Goldiam has 26 operational stores under the brand name ORIGEM across key cities.

capex_expansion.claim: ORIGEM now operates 26 operational stores across 13 cities in India.
capex_expansion.quote: ORIGEM, Goldiam’s India retail lab grown diamond jewellery brand, now operates 26 operational stores across 13 cities in India.

capex_expansion.claim: ORIGEM doubled its store count from January 2026 to 24 operational stores across 12 cities.
capex_expansion.quote: From January 2026 till now, ORIGEM, Goldiam's India retail lab-grown diamond jewelry brand has doubled its store count, now having 24 operational stores across 12 cities.

capex_expansion.claim: There are 8 to 10 more ORIGEM stores planned to be operational by September 2026.
capex_expansion.quote: There are 8 more ORIGEM stores coming up -- 8 to 10 more ORIGEM stores coming up, and they'll be all operational by September 2026.

capex_expansion.claim: The total cash outflow required to open one ORIGEM store is approximately INR3.5 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: So all in, if you add these 3 buckets up, the total expense to open an ORIGEM store or cash out to open an ORIGEM store is about INR3.5 crores, give or take a certain amount.

margins_costs.claim: Steady-state EBITDA margin post-tariff refund calibration grew by 400 basis points to 24% in Q1 FY27.
margins_costs.quote: Steady state EBITDA margin post-tariff refund calibration grew by 400 basis points to 24%.

margins_costs.claim: Management highlighted that the dual and hybrid casting method helps avoid the brunt of changing tariffs while improving margins.
margins_costs.quote: This is as per our definition, including OI. And yes, we are happy to showcase these results in Q1 FY27, where steady state margin -- EBITDA margin has inched up to 24%, significantly higher than Q1 FY26 or FY26 as a whole. This is, again, walking the talk as to what we have shared on our prior commitment and driven by the dual and hybrid casting method where we are casting in the U.S., delivering U.S. product of origin as a key supply chain solution for our customers whilst also not bearing the brunt of changing tariffs regardless of what they are.

margins_costs.claim: The recent increase in customs duty on gold to 15% will not materially impact operations, financial performance, or profitability because the company operates from an SEZ.
margins_costs.quote: The recent increase in Customs Duty on gold to 15%, comprising 10% Basic Customs Duty (BCD) and 5% cess, we would like to inform you that the said increase shall not have any material impact on the operations, financial performance, or profitability of the Company.

margins_costs.claim: The hybrid casting model in the United States helps deliver business continuity and margin growth.
margins_costs.quote: At Goldiam on the B2B side, the hybrid casting method where we are casting in the United States has truly been instrumental to help delivering business continuity for ourselves, our customers and in general, in the jewelry industry as well as to help deliver margin growth within the company.

margins_costs.claim: Management expects an incremental gross margin impact of 200 to 300 basis points on a full year basis from the U.S. casting model.
margins_costs.quote: It's about between 200 to 300 basis point increment that we are expecting on a full year basis.

orders_capacity.claim: Goldiam's order book position as on June 30, 2026 was about INR2,250 million.
orders_capacity.quote: Goldiam's order book position as on June 30, 2026 was about INR2,250 million.

orders_capacity.claim: The order book position as of June 30, 2026, was approximately ₹2,250 million.
orders_capacity.quote: Goldiam’s order book position as on June 30, 2026 was at about ₹ 2250 million.

orders_capacity.claim: Goldiam's order book position as of March 31, 2026, was approximately INR2,000 million.
orders_capacity.quote: Goldiam's order book position as on March 31, 2026, was at about INR2,000 million.

orders_capacity.claim: Eco-Friendly Diamonds operates about 30 machines nonstop within the facility in SEZ.
orders_capacity.quote: So we have about 30 machines within the facility in SEZ that are operating nonstop.

capital_allocation.claim: In July, the company allotted 3,76,39,281 equity shares as fully paid-up bonus equity shares in a 1:3 proportion.
capital_allocation.quote: In July, the company allotted 3,76,39,281 equity shares of INR2 each as fully paid up bonus equity shares in the proportion of 1:3 by utilizing an amount of INR7,52,78,562.

capital_allocation.claim: Cash and cash equivalents including investments were ₹4,566.71 million as of June 2026.
capital_allocation.quote: Cash and Cash Equivalents (including investments) were at ₹ 4566.71 million as at June, 2026.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board of Directors recommended a bonus share issue in the ratio of 1:3.
capital_allocation.quote: The Board of Directors has recommended a bonus share in the ratio 1:3 fully paid up equity shares of INR2 each in proportion of new fully paid up equity share of INR2 for every 3 existing fully paid up equity shares of INR2 each, subject to the approval of shareholders.

capital_allocation.claim: Cash and cash equivalents including investments were at INR4,933.92 million as of March 31, 2026.
capital_allocation.quote: Cash and cash equivalents, including investments were at INR4,933.92 million as on March 31, 2026.

risks_headwinds.claim: Goldiam began casting raw gold into unfinished jewellery pieces in the US to address the steep hike in US tariffs.
risks_headwinds.quote: In September 2025, in response to the steep hike in US tariffs, through its U.S. subsidiary, Goldiam began casting raw gold into unfinished jewellery pieces within the United States itself, providing employment and job opportunities domestically in the US.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management stated that the company is tariff agnostic and custom duty increases on gold will not have a material impact.
risks_headwinds.quote: Here, I would like you to note that Goldiam is tariff agnostic and the recent increase in custom duty in India on gold to 15% will not have any material impact on Goldiam's operations, financial performance or profitability.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects to report double-digit growth in non-American areas by the end of the year.
management_commitments.quote: So we hope to increase that number in a good way by the end of the year. So we'll be able to report to you that we'll have a double-digit growth in non-American areas as well.

management_commitments.claim: Management aims to open 7 newly signed ORIGEM stores before pre-Diwali.
management_commitments.quote: These 7 stores will come in come in between now and our target is to get them open before -- by pre-Diwali.

management_commitments.claim: The order book position of about ₹2,250 million is expected to be executed in the next three to four months.
management_commitments.quote: This order book is expected to be executed in next three-four months.

management_commitments.claim: ORIGEM targets an exit revenue of about INR7 crores per month for FY27.
management_commitments.quote: So we are hoping and targeting an exit revenue of about INR7 crores per month for FY '27 for the ORIGEM business.

management_commitments.claim: For the first half of fiscal 2027, ORIGEM plans to spend between INR4 crores to INR4.5 crores in marketing expenses.
management_commitments.quote: For the first half of fiscal 2027, we are looking forward to spend between INR4 crores to INR4.5 crores in marketing expense.

management_commitments.claim: An additional 8 to 10 ORIGEM stores will be operational by September 2026.
management_commitments.quote: There are 8 more ORIGEM stores coming up -- 8 to 10 more ORIGEM stores coming up, and they'll be all operational by September 2026.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
